rationale: Greenfield repo with no existing subsystem edited and every file additive and revertible by deleting the repo, though the papers/*.md front-matter format is a contract a future site will parse, and the open questions (d11 split, marking-script runtime) are builder-deferred rather than design-changing.

signals.blast_radius: New standalone repo with an aggregator pom, about 15 Maven projects (~250 files), lessons, scripts and papers; nothing existing is modified or moved
signals.unresolved: Only builder-deferred choices remain: whether d11 splits into two drills (adds one module) and whether marking runs via .sh+.cmd or a Java runner; the LBP date is a fact to confirm, not a design input
signals.irreversibility: Low: additive to a new repo and revertible by deleting it or the private GitHub repo; the papers/*.md schema becomes costly to change only once the future site imports it
